name: NTZ Bid Copilot
description: Enterprise proposal intelligence for Microsoft 365 Copilot. Drafts RFP responses, security questionnaires, capability statements, and bid documents using SharePoint grounding.

conversation_starters.title: Draft RFP Responses
conversation_starters.text: Draft responses to this RFP using our previous answer library, capability statements, and proposal templates. Highlight any unanswered requirements.

conversation_starters.title: Complete Security Questionnaire
conversation_starters.text: Complete this security questionnaire using our security documents and flag questions requiring SME review.

conversation_starters.title: Generate Executive Summary
conversation_starters.text: Generate an executive summary aligned to the customer's priorities using our proposal playbook.

conversation_starters.title: Review Proposal
conversation_starters.text: Review this proposal against our bid playbook and identify risks, gaps, and improvement opportunities.

conversation_starters.title: Generate Proposal Document
conversation_starters.text: Generate a professionally formatted .docx version of the proposal, RFP response, or security questionnaire discussed in this conversation.

conversation_starters.title: Generate Proposal Cover
conversation_starters.text: Generate a professional proposal cover page or bid presentation graphic using GraphicArt.
